1.1.42 — Meet calls float

  • Your call, in the corner. Switch away from a Google Meet call (or press ⌃⌘P) and the whole call floats in a small window that stays on top, live, on every desktop.
  • Controls right there. Hover it to mute, turn your camera off, raise your hand or leave. Drag the top edge to move it, the edges to resize.
  • Back in one click. The button in the corner, or the call's tab, puts it back where it was. Leaving the call does too.

1.1.41 — Ask is off for now

  • Ask is switched off. The Ask panel, ⌘E and asking from a new tab are off while Ask is being reworked. It'll come back once it's ready.
  • Everything else is the same. Typing in a new tab searches or opens sites as usual.

1.1.40 — Ask looks things up

  • Ask searches the web. Questions the page can't answer — service times, opening hours, addresses, prices — are looked up on the web and the site's other pages, with sources you can open.
  • No more dead ends. If the page doesn't say, Pane searches instead of stopping there, and follow-ups keep track of what you were asking about.
  • Cleaner answers. No more stray "untrusted" markers or asterisks in replies.
